description: Closed catalog of reasons a fundamentals observation may be absent or invalid. Per phase-5 rule 3.3, none of these may ever be silently converted to zero.

missing_reasons.meaning: The company did not disclose this figure for this period (common for OdP/ordinary income under IFRS/USGAAP filers, or optional line items).
The metric does not apply to this statement/period type (e.g. EPS on a balance-sheet-only record).
The provider does not expose this field at all on the plan/endpoint used (e.g. detailed debt breakdown, gated behind a paid tier we do not use).
The provider returned a response missing expected fields or truncated mid-record.
The record could not be confidently attributed to the correct company/asset.
The provider returned an HTTP or schema error for this request.
The normalizer could not map the raw field/value into the canonical schema (e.g. unrecognized unit or currency).
The value was structurally valid but failed a validation rule (accounting equation, temporal check, etc.) and was blocked, not corrected.
A derived metric could not be computed because one or more required reported components are missing or blocked.
Whether this metric exists for this asset/period has not yet been checked.
